_readme: Verified authors and official plugins are configured in this file, maintained by the DeepGuard pipeline (no human review step exists anywhere in the project). Effective priority: plugins > authors > orgs/auto (automated verification) > report fields. orgs lists trusted GitHub organizations: when an author login is the organization account itself, the author is automatically verified and its plugins become official (when the org has official:true). scripts/verify-identities.js periodically checks whether the remaining authors are public members of orgs and writes results into the auto section (do not edit auto by hand). After any change run node scripts/build-index.js to take effect; pushing to main triggers the build-index workflow to rebuild automatically.
_criteria: Verified author inclusion policy (community authors; all conditions must hold; when in doubt, do not include):
1. GitHub account registered >= 180 days with normal historical activity (not a shell or farmed account)
2. No confirmed malicious record among listed plugins; author and repositories absent from active entries in reports/_blacklist.json
3. Author has actual control over the plugin repository (OWNER or write-level COLLABORATOR, same standard as the intake gate)
4. Inclusion must fill in note recording the verification basis; revocation: explicitly set verified:false to remove the badge
